annotation.title_clean: Tanggungjawab Perubatan dalam Pembedahan yang Dibantu Robot Menurut Perspektif Etika Islam dan Fiqh
annotation.title_en: Medical Responsibility in Robot-Assisted Surgery from Islamic Ethical and Fiqh Perspectives
annotation.summary_en: Malay-language article analysing medical responsibility in robot-assisted surgery through Islamic ethics and fiqh. It examines ethical, criminal and contractual liability (qiṣāṣ, taʿzīr, ḍamān) of surgeons, hospitals, manufacturers and engineers, proposing a Shariah-compliant accountability model ensuring justice and patient safety.
key_provisions_or_claims: Medical responsibility in robotic surgery is legal liability via qiṣāṣ, taʿzīr or ḍamān.
Liability extends to surgeons, medical teams, hospitals, manufacturers and maintenance engineers.
Hospitals bear ḍamān for negligence in training, maintenance or supervision and contractual liability (ijarah).
Fiqh distinguishes direct (mubāsharah) from indirect (tasabbub) causation in assigning fault.
Proposes a comprehensive Shariah-compliant accountability framework for justice and patient safety.
